entries.author: agent:build-ai-visibility-panel
entries.summary: First candidate panel built from one public URL plus a one-line description. 50 canonical cells, 92 generated candidates, 86 accepted, 5 quarantined, 1 sent back for revision, 3 rejected pre-QA.

inputs.description: Cloudflare is a network platform spanning CDN and performance, application security, Zero Trust and SASE, DNS, and edge compute.

decisions_of_record: Charter estimands set provisionally to unaided_brand_presence, category-aided presence, competitive_mention_share, citation_presence, answer_framing and aided_brand_knowledge, each with its own denominator. campaign_response declared out of scope.
funnel left null on all 50 cells because no evidence links these jobs to a funnel model.
Acts 'generate' and 'navigate' omitted as unsupported rather than padded in.
icp-005 (developer/edge compute) kept hypothesis_only despite appearing in the user's description, because only company-asserted evidence supports it.
Equal exposure and priority weights adopted with an explicit non-prevalence limitation.
Randomization seed deliberately left null because no runtime was available to generate and freeze one.

planned_version_triggers.trigger: Any Gate 3 or Gate 4 approval that changes core membership, weights, metric definitions or surface mix
Variance pilot completion and reallocation of repeats versus cells
B5 evidence expiry on 2026-09-15 for cell-032, cell-033 and cell-051
Promotion of any quarantined cell (cell-018, cell-044, cell-045, cell-046, cell-047) after new evidence
Addition of a non-English locale after market-competent review
First human freeze of a fully approved panel
